evidence: Touches `ci/test/03_test_script.sh` to configure how IWYU runs in CI.
rationale: Prevents CI from running IWYU on subtrees only to immediately discard the changes with git restore. As noted in the description, 'Every run prints IWYU suggestions for 14 libmultiprocess files in the non-enforced pass, applies them, and then reverts them', so skipping them cleans up CI logs and avoids wasteful analysis.
